title: Customize Your Own Sales Actions
desc: SalesAssist aims to help businesses across all industries. We let businesses build customized, no-code workflow steps using our simple graphical user interface web portal, based on your own needs and logic.

show_case.title: Select a Sales Action template
show_case.desc: Choose off-the-shelf Sales Action templates from our evergrowing Template Library.

show_case.title: Customize your own
show_case.desc: Modify texts, images, logos, documents, and page layout on the Sales Actions based on your needs.

show_case.title: Add to your Action Panel
show_case.desc: Turn on and off Sales Actions on the Action Panel and list them in the sequence you prefer.
